rows.commentary: 0.1: Mahedi Hasan starts his spell, drifting one in to pin Croospulle down with a watchful defensive prod into the off-side.
0.2: Mahedi Hasan pushes it through again, and Croospulle meets it with a straight bat, offering no room for error.
0.3: Mahedi Hasan tosses it up, and Croospulle nudges it into the short cover region to finally turn the strike over for a single.
0.4: Mahedi Hasan loops it up to Sineth Jayawardena, who defends solidly right back to the bowler.
0.5: Mahedi Hasan slides another one in on a length, and Sineth Jayawardena pushes it straight to the infield for no run.
0.6: Mahedi Hasan loops it up, Sineth Jayawardena rocks back and guides it firmly away to deep square leg for a single.
1.1: Aliss Al Islam steams in to Sineth Jayawardena, it beats everyone and scurries away for two byes.
1.2: Aliss Al Islam loops it up to Sineth Jayawardena, who drives crisply to extra cover for a single.
1.3: Aliss Al Islam slides it through, and Croospulle steers it down to third man to rotate the strike.
1.4: Aliss Al Islam zips the arm ball in with sharp angle, catching the inside edge of Sineth Jayawardena's bat straight onto the pads for no run.
1.5: Aliss Al Islam drifts this one outside off with vicious turn, leaving Sineth Jayawardena groping and comprehensively beaten on the defensive prod.
1.6: Aliss Al Islam floats it up and Sineth Jayawardena steers a quick single away towards backward point to rotate the strike.
2.1: Mahedi Hasan strikes with precision, slipping one past Sineth Jayawardena's defenses to crash into the stumps and send him back for 3.
2.2: Mahedi Hasan loops it up short, Sohan de Livera creates room to punch it cleanly to cover for no run.
2.3: Mahedi Hasan strays slightly, and Sohan de Livera deftly guides it away to the third man boundary for four.
2.4: Mahedi Hasan keeps it tight, allowing Sohan de Livera just a single flicked away towards backward square leg.
2.5: Mahedi Hasan loops it up, Croospulle drives tentatively, and Yasir Ali gobbles up the catch sharply in the field.
2.6: Mahedi Hasan sprays this one well down the leg side, drifting past Nuwanidu Fernando as five wides are signalled by the umpire.
2.6: Mahedi Hasan straightens it up, allowing Nuwanidu Fernando to nudge a single away towards point.
3.1: Aliss Al Islam strikes with precision as Nuwanidu Fernando edges it straight into the waiting gloves of Litton Das!
3.2: Aliss Al Islam loops it in on a length, Sahan Arachchige presses forward with a dead bat, and the ball thuds solidly into the turf with no run offered.
3.3: Aliss Al Islam loops it in to Sahan Arachchige, an urgent stifled appeal rings out, but the umpire shakes his head as it sails safely past.
3.4: Aliss Al Islam strays wide of the mark to Sahan Arachchige, extra runs handed over on the scoreboard.
3.4: Aliss Al Islam tosses it up to Sahan Arachchige, gently nudged away towards short fine leg for a sharp single.
3.5: Aliss Al Islam loops it in, Sohan de Livera completes one but a lightning throw from Mustafizur Rahman to Litton Das catches him short of his ground to end his brisk six-run cameo!
3.6: Aliss Al Islam unleashes a sharp carrom ball darting away past the off stump, catching Ashen Bandara's misjudged cut as it dies toward cover.
4.1: Mahedi Hasan loops one in to grip and turn off a full length, drawing Sahan Arachchige forward into a watchful defensive prod toward the off side.
4.2: Mahedi Hasan tosses up a slower, fuller delivery, allowing Sahan Arachchige to get low and sweep it firmly away to deep backward square leg for a single.
4.3: Mahedi Hasan maintains his disciplined length to Ashen Bandara, who safely negotiates the delivery with a watchful dot ball.
4.4: Mahedi Hasan loops it in, and Ashen Bandara works it smoothly away to mid-wicket for a single.
4.5: Mahedi Hasan loops this shortish delivery outside off, and Sahan Arachchige expertly rides the bounce to cut it straight to point.
4.6: Mahedi Hasan darts it in from round the wicket, Sahan Arachchige inner-halves the tuck toward short fine, and they scramble through for a sharp single.
5.1: Nasum Ahmed slides it in, and Sahan Arachchige sweeps with supreme control, rifling the ball away to the backward square leg boundary for four.
5.2: Nasum Ahmed floats one in on a slower length outside off, and Sahan Arachchige waits patiently to turn it away to the bowler's left for a single.
5.3: Nasum Ahmed lands it on a length, drifting in before gripping and spinning away sharply to beat Ashen Bandara's forward defensive push all ends up.
5.4: Nasum Ahmed keeps up the pressure with another probing delivery, safely negotiated by Ashen Bandara.
5.5: Nasum Ahmed finishes off another tight delivery, completely smothered by the watchful Ashen Bandara.
5.6: Nasum Ahmed loops it in on a length, and Ashen Bandara pushes it firmly back down the pitch for a dot.
6.1: Mahedi Hasan drops it full outside off, Sahan Arachchige unleashes the sweep, but the sharp turn and extra bounce completely deceive the batsman.
6.2: Mahedi Hasan delivers to Sahan Arachchige, who nudges it away smoothly down to long-off for a single.
6.3: Mahedi Hasan darts it in quicker around off stump, catching the leading edge of Ashen Bandara to drop safely into the turf just in front of him.
6.4: Mahedi Hasan goes back to work, and Ashen Bandara nudges this one away towards backward square leg to pick up a single.
6.5: Mahedi Hasan loops it up to Sahan Arachchige, who pushes defensively as it dies just short of the fielder stationed at first slip.
6.6: Mahedi Hasan floats the final delivery of the over into Sahan Arachchige, who nudges it out towards sweeper cover for a single.
7.1: Nasum Ahmed angles it in, and Sahan Arachchige defends it right back to the bowler.

11.1: Saif Hassan flights it in, and Sahan Arachchige neatly clips it away for a single to keep the scoreboard ticking over.

18.1: Mustafizur Rahman strikes as Tharindu Ratnayake holes out to Rishad Hossain, ending a blistering knock of 65 featuring seven fours and five sixes.
18.2: Mustafizur Rahman steams in and restricts Dushan Hemantha to a dot with a clever variation.

19.1: Saif Hassan darts one in, Wanuja Sahan misses the line, and the batters scamper through for a leg bye.

19.3: Saif Hassan strikes with absolute precision, cleaning up Sahan Arachchige for a determined 33 as the timber rattles and the batsman departs.

0.1: Nuwan Thushara steams in and starts with a sharp delivery, defended solidly by Saif Hassan for no run.

13.6: Wanuja Sahan finishes the over with a tight delivery, blocked safely right back to the bowler by Aliss Al Islam for no run.
14.1: Dushan Hemantha loops this one into the middle and leg channel, and Nasum Ahmed plays the slog with an inside edge trickling away to short fine leg for a single.
14.2: Dushan Hemantha delivers to Aliss Al Islam, who works it down the ground toward long-on to comfortably collect a single.
14.3: Dushan Hemantha tosses it up full, and Nasum Ahmed plays it solidly back to the bowler for no run.
14.4: Dushan Hemantha loops it in, and Nasum Ahmed works it away smoothly into the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
14.5: Dushan Hemantha crashes through the defense, shattering the stumps to dismiss Aliss Al Islam for 4.
14.6: Dushan Hemantha loops it up, Mustafizur Rahman drives firmly toward deep extra cover, and they scamper through for a single.
15.1: Wanuja Sahan tosses it up around off, and Mustafizur Rahman drills it flat down to long-off for a single.
15.2: Wanuja Sahan continues, and Nasum Ahmed works it away cleanly into the mid-wicket region to rotate the strike.
15.3: Wanuja Sahan loops it up, and Mustafizur Rahman drills it straight down the ground for a single.
15.4: Wanuja Sahan bowls to Nasum Ahmed, who lofts it out to long-on and scampers back for two runs.
15.5: Wanuja Sahan floats it up, Nasum Ahmed drives it down to long-on for a single.
15.6: Wanuja Sahan finishes the over strongly, beating Mustafizur Rahman with a sharp dot ball.
16.1: Nuwan Thushara spears it full and tailing in, and Nasum Ahmed does exceptionally well to squeeze it out into the turf.
16.2: Nuwan Thushara strays just outside the tramlines, and the umpire stretches the arms to signal a wide.
16.2: Nuwan Thushara spears in a searing yorker-length delivery on the stumps, and Nasum Ahmed smartly backs away just in time to jam it firmly towards cover.
16.3: Nuwan Thushara delivers and Nasum Ahmed launches it imperiously over the rope for a maximum!
16.4: Nuwan Thushara steams in again, pitching it for Nasum Ahmed, who knocks it down to long-on for a single.
16.5: Nuwan Thushara spears it in at Mustafizur Rahman, who keeps his bat down and plays it solidly back to the bowler for no run.
16.6: Nuwan Thushara targets the off stump with a fullish length, and Mustafizur Rahman plays a watchful defensive stroke as the ball trickles away toward mid-off.
17.1: Sahan Arachchige slides one in from a length, and Nasum Ahmed merely under-edges the cut skidding away to the right of the wicketkeeper.
17.2: Sahan Arachchige fires it in flat and full, and Nasum Ahmed stands his ground to defend it solidly back down the pitch.
17.3: Sahan Arachchige entices Nasum Ahmed into the big shot, finding Ashen Bandara in the deep to end a twenty-six run resistance.
